verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only manual, in-app ways to add and edit codes: scanning QR codes, swiping to edit, and QR-based transfer. No API, CLI, or other programmatic surface lets an agent seed TOTP secrets or store credentials. The GitHub OTP implementations and PAM module are developer building blocks for generating or verifying codes, not a vault-entry management interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can create and update vault entries — seeding new TOTP secrets, storing credentials — through documented programmatic surfaces
